messages:
deploy-bot: Canary alert for rwd-runtime v2.10.0-hotpatch — error-rate +4.1% (threshold 3%), p95 +120ms. Canary at 10% traffic. Auto-slowdown triggered.
Maria G: Noted. Starting triage. @Sam can you pull traces + logs for kv-cache OOMs?
Sam T: On it. grabbing flamegraphs and OOM stack traces now. Saw a few OOMs from kv-cache when seq_len > 800.
Chen L: If kv-cache OOMs correlate, that explains tail latency. Recommend pin to previous stable and stop canary rather than full auto-rollback (we want controlled revert).
Maria G: Agreed. Criteria: customer-facing error >2% sustained for 5m -> manual rollback. This matches. I'll request a manual pin.
Alex P: Heads up — if we roll back we should update release notes + send brief customer note for any impacted dedicated customers. Who can draft?
Maria G: I'll draft comms in #customer-success after we have confirmation. @ops-bot please open an incident ticket and attach current canary telemetry.
ops-bot: Incident created: INC-4721 (rwd-runtime hotpatch canary error spike). Link: https://incidents.internal/INC-4721
deploy-bot: Canary paused by manual action. Current traffic frozen at 10%. Waiting rollback command.
Maria G: Executing rollback pin now: `/deploy rollback --service=rwd-runtime --to-version=2.9.8 --mode=manual --reason="kv-cache OOM in canary"`
deploy-bot: Rollback initiated by Maria G. Unrouting canary and pinning traffic to v2.9.8. Expected churn window ~2 min.
Sam T: Metrics watching: p95 and error-rate streaming. Will confirm stabilization.
Chen L: After rollback, plan: revert kernel flag change in next patch, add extra kv-cache guardrail (reject seq_len>700) and run stress test.
Alex P: Thanks. Once rollback completes, please add a short note to release notes: "2.10.0-hotpatch rolled back due to canary kv-cache OOMs; pin to 2.9.8." I'll prep a customer-facing blurb.
Maria G: Rollback finished — deploy-bot reports healthy on v2.9.8, error-rate back to baseline. Closing canary.
deploy-bot: Canary closed. Telemetry: error-rate delta now -0.1% vs baseline, p95 within 10ms.
Sam T: Verified traces cleared; no residual OOMs. I'll leave monitoring on for 1h and then hand off.
Maria G: Thanks team. Follow-up actions: (1) Chen to prepare patch with kv-cache guardrail, (2) QA to run extended canary with synthetic load, (3) Alex to finalize customer note. Filing follow-up ticket in INC-4721. :thumbsup:
